data.overview: Cult Beauty is a London-based online beauty retailer that markets a "Cult Conscious" transparency programme powered by Provenance to surface independently verified sustainability Proof Points across its brands. Company-published sources describe packaging targets (part of THG and the UK Plastics Pact) and a more:trees partnership, while a Provenance case study reports the programme drove higher conversion and shopper sentiment. No independent safety, cruelty-free, vegan, or labour evidence appears in the fetched sources.

claims.claim: Cult Beauty runs a transparency initiative called Cult Conscious, powered by Provenance, that logs independently verified impact claims for products.
claims.quote: Powered by Provenance, a software solution that uses blockchain technology to log impact claims, this increasingly in-demand program acknowledges a product’s ethical credentials with clear, independently investigated (and verified!) Proof Points.

papers.title: How Cult Beauty drove +31% higher conversion rates with validated green claims
papers.fundingDisclosure: Published by Provenance, the software vendor whose claims-validation platform Cult Beauty uses; the source does not state independent funding.
papers.summary: This Provenance case study describes how Cult Beauty integrated Provenance-validated sustainability Proof Points into its Cult Conscious edit, search filters, and product pages, reporting a +31% conversion rate and +5% shopper sentiment increase from a 23,000-customer survey. Because Provenance is the vendor that supplies the claims-validation platform, the source has a commercial interest in presenting Cult Beauty's outcomes favourably.

findings.text: Cult Beauty reports it built its Cult Conscious programme on Provenance's validated Proof Point data across a large portion of its product range.
findings.quote: Using Provenance’s Proof Point data, Cult Beauty has delivered its highly successful Cult Conscious edit and beauty box, configured values-based search filters and enhanced PDPs

findings.text: The case study attributes measurable commercial gains to Cult Beauty publishing validated sustainability claims.
findings.quote: Cult Beauty drove improved post-purchase shopper sentiment by 5% (according to a survey of 23k customers) by publishing transparent, validated sustainability claims.
